spec.name: SG13 target-conditioned region inference
spec.partition: SPEC32, fixed from VOC SG4 evidence and protocol preference; no partition selection on COCO
spec.scale: c is the standard minmax CA seed; mu is raw mean_i A_i*c; Q is raw directional consensus; region scores are not renormalized
spec.candidate_thresholds: 0 through 1 inclusive by 0.005; one global score threshold selected on VOC training folds
spec.mask: threshold each raw region score, then nearest-neighbor expand region identities to annotation resolution; no bilinear boundary blending for SG13
spec.control_mask: legacy per-map minmax then bilinear upsampling and thresholding, exactly as existing results
spec.oracle: SG4 majority oracle: GT nearest-downsampled to 64x64; occupied region positive at >=50% GT target; oracle mask nearest-expanded to annotation size
spec.selection: existing VOC five folds and run_screen promotion/class guards; independent R1/R2/R3 screens plus joint three-rule screen, tie preference R1 then R2 then R3; controls retain original thresholds
spec.visual_sampling: first manifest image per named VOC class; boat is an additional strong SG2-improvement class
spec.storage: atomic counts/AP plus per-image at-most-32 region quantities/scores/GT fractions and oracle counts; six tiny temporary visual caches only
